privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Boolaa is a free, private, invite-only app for small groups ("bubbles"). This policy explains what personal data we process when you use the Boolaa app and website, why, and what your rights are. The short version: we use your data only to run Boolaa, and for nothing else.

sections.title: Who we are
body: Boolaa isn't a company. It's a free, not-for-profit project made with joy by one private individual, Bogdan Raduta, who is the data controller for your personal data. In this policy, "we" and "us" mean him.

Write to privacy@boolaa.ro for privacy and data requests, to hello@boolaa.ro for general questions and to moderation@boolaa.ro for safety reports. A postal address for the controller is provided on request via privacy@boolaa.ro.
Boolaa doesn't need to appoint a Data Protection Officer (DPO). Requests sent to privacy@boolaa.ro reach the person responsible for your data directly.

We process personal data under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable Romanian law. The supervisory authority is the Romanian National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP).

sections.title: Data we collect
body: We only collect what's needed to run the service: an email address for your account, and what you choose to post.
- Account data: your email address, name and, if you add one, your profile photo, plus your confirmation that you're 16 or older and the version of these terms you accepted.
- Content you post: chat messages, events (title, description, date, place, who is going), food posts, marketplace items, shared links and the images you upload.
- Membership data: the bubbles you create or belong to, your role, join requests and approvals.
- Safety data: the people you block and the reports you send or that concern you.
- Security data: the devices you've chosen to trust and the short-lived security codes we email you.
- Technical data: server logs (such as IP address, device and browser type, time of requests and errors) needed to run and secure the service.
We don't ask for or want sensitive data. Please don't post health, financial or similar information in your bubbles.

sections.title: Signing in with Apple or Google
body: If you choose to sign in with Apple or Google, we receive only your name and email address from them. If you use Apple's "Hide My Email", we receive an Apple relay address that forwards to your inbox. We don't receive your password or anything else from your Apple or Google account.
Apple and Google handle that sign-in under their own privacy policies. If you sign in with an email and password, they aren't involved.

sections.title: Why we use your data and on what legal basis
body: - To provide Boolaa (your account, your bubbles and everything you share in them): performance of our contract with you (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
- To keep Boolaa safe (security codes and new-device checks, handling reports, blocking, preventing abuse and securing our systems): our legitimate interest in a safe service (Art. 6(1)(f)).
- To meet legal obligations (for example answering lawful requests from authorities): legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)).
Your data is used only to run the service. In particular:
- We don't sell your data or share it for marketing.
- We don't show ads, and we don't track or profile you. There are no third-party trackers or analytics.
- We don't use your content or data to train artificial intelligence or machine-learning models, and we don't allow anyone else to.
- Boolaa is free: no fees, no subscriptions and no in-app purchases, so we hold no payment data.

sections.title: Who can see your data
body: Content you post in a bubble is visible only to that bubble's members. Your name and photo are visible to people who share a bubble with you. People you block, and people who block you, no longer see each other's content.
We use these processors, bound by data processing agreements and only to run the service:
- Supabase (database, authentication and file storage), with our data hosted in Zurich, Switzerland.
- DigitalOcean, which hosts the website and app server in Frankfurt, Germany.
- Resend, which sends our emails (such as sign-up confirmations and security codes).
- Cloudflare, for DNS and for forwarding email sent to our @boolaa.ro addresses.
- Apple and Google, only if you choose to sign in with them.
We share data with authorities only when the law requires it.

sections.title: International transfers
body: Your data is stored in Switzerland (Supabase, Zurich) and served from the EU (DigitalOcean, Frankfurt). Switzerland has an adequacy decision from the European Commission, so the GDPR allows transfers there without extra safeguards.

Some processors (Resend, Cloudflare and, if you sign in with them, Apple or Google) may handle limited data, such as your email address, outside the EU/EEA. In that case we rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or another valid transfer mechanism.

sections.title: How long we keep data
body: We keep your data for as long as you have an account. When you delete your account in the app, we delete your profile, your content and your images, and remove you from your bubbles.
Security codes expire within minutes. Trusted devices stay on your list until you remove them or delete your account.

Reports you sent may be kept for up to 12 months after they are closed, without your account, to handle repeated abuse. Technical logs are kept for a short period (usually up to 30 days) unless needed to investigate a security incident.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You have the right to access your data, to rectify it, to erase it, to receive it in a portable format, to restrict or object to its processing, and to withdraw any consent at any time.
You can edit your profile and delete your content or your whole account directly in the app. For anything else, write to privacy@boolaa.ro. We answer within one month.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with ANSPDCP (www.dataprotection.ro) or with the supervisory authority where you live.

sections.title: Minimum age
body: Boolaa is for people aged 16 and over, and you confirm your age when you sign up. If we learn that someone younger has an account, we will delete it.

sections.title: Security
body: Data is encrypted in transit, access is restricted by row-level security so only the right people can read each bubble, and passwords are stored hashed.

When you sign in on a new device, we may email you a security code to confirm it's you, and we may ask for a fresh code before sensitive actions such as deleting your account. You can see the list of your trusted devices in the app and remove any of them.
No system is perfectly secure, so please use a strong, unique password.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy as Boolaa changes. We will show the new date at the top and, for important changes, tell you in the app before they take effect.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms are the agreement between you and Bogdan Raduta, the private individual who runs Boolaa, for using the Boolaa service at boolaa.ro and in the Boolaa apps. In these terms, "we" and "us" mean him. By creating an account you accept them, together with our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Who can use Boolaa
body: You must be at least 16 years old. You are responsible for your account: keep your password safe, give accurate information and tell us if you think someone else is using your account.

sections.title: The service
body: Boolaa lets you create private bubbles, invite people with a code, and chat, plan events, share food, swap items and share links with your bubble's members.

Boolaa is free and not-for-profit: no fees, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases and no ads. It isn't run by a company, but made with joy by one person. We may change, add or remove features over time, or stop the service; if we stop it, we'll tell you in advance so you can save what matters to you.

sections.title: Acceptable use
body: Be kind. You must not use Boolaa to post or do anything that:
- harasses, bullies, threatens or intimidates anyone;
- promotes hate or discrimination against people or groups;
- contains sexual content involving minors, in any form (we report it to the authorities);
- offers illegal goods or services, including in the marketplace (for example drugs, weapons, stolen or counterfeit goods);
- is spam, a scam or misleading;
- infringes someone else's rights, including privacy and intellectual property;
- attempts to break, overload or get around the security of the service.

sections.title: Reporting, blocking and moderation
body: We have zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive users. You can report any message, event, post, item, link or member from the app, and block anyone so you no longer see each other's content. You can also write to moderation@boolaa.ro.
We review reports within 24 hours. We may remove content, and suspend or terminate the accounts of people who break these terms, without notice when needed to protect others.

sections.title: Your content
body: You keep ownership of everything you post. You give us only the licence needed to run Boolaa: a non-exclusive, free, worldwide licence to store, process and display your content to the members of the bubbles where you post it. We don't use your content for anything else, including advertising or training AI models. The licence ends when you delete the content or your account.
You confirm you have the right to share what you post.

sections.title: Open source
body: Boolaa's source code is open source under the Apache License 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). That licence covers the code: you may use, modify and share it under its conditions. The code is public at https://github.com/unalome-ai/boolaa.

The licence doesn't cover the hosted service. Your use of Boolaa at boolaa.ro and in the Boolaa apps, including your account and your content, is governed by these terms. The Apache License doesn't grant rights to the Boolaa name or logo.

sections.title: Marketplace
body: The marketplace is peer-to-peer. Boolaa is not a party to any giveaway or trade, does not check items and is not responsible for their quality, safety or legality. Agree on the details directly with the other person and take care when meeting.

sections.title: Disclaimers and liability
body: Boolaa is a free, non-commercial service run by one individual. It is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, to the extent permitted by law. We work to keep it available and secure but can't guarantee it will always be uninterrupted or error-free, or that your content will never be lost.

To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, for loss of data or content, or for content posted by other users, except for damage caused intentionally or through gross negligence. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or your rights as a consumer.

sections.title: Ending the agreement
body: You can stop using Boolaa and delete your account at any time in the app. We may suspend or end your access if you seriously or repeatedly break these terms, or if the law requires it.

sections.title: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by Romanian law. Disputes go to the competent courts of Romania, without affecting the mandatory consumer protection rules of the country where you live.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms. We will show the new date at the top and tell you in the app before important changes take effect. If you keep using Boolaa after that, the new terms apply.
